acceptance: Private FacioMGA/facio-kernel contains the existing clean foundation with provenance preserved.

items.title: Execute versioned insurance records and exact financial allocations
acceptance: Synthetic external quote capture and revision, exact stored-version bind, endorsement, cancellation and reinstatement work through canonical commands and connected UI.
Strict minor-unit arithmetic conserves gross participant allocations and separately calculates explicit commission without a custody or ledger claim.
Scoped immutable snapshots/events, current state, audit, command idempotency and pending outbox are atomic and survive restart.
A durable scoped product/external-reference identity prevents separate records for the same source quote across actors and idempotency keys; new source versions revise the existing record.
Stale, expired, referred, declined, unauthorized, cross-scope and unsupported-prerequisite operations fail; MCP cannot invoke insurance mutations.
Local domain/HTTP/MCP/browser checks and remote CI pass. Customer acceptance remains separate.

acceptance: Typed product/risk/coverage and authority rules select immutable effective versions; draft edits cannot change active or historical transactions.
Eligibility, referral, approval, rating and bind prerequisites are separate evidence-backed decisions with explicit precedence.
Implement the bounded sandbox release/policy path and tested missing-capability blockers; production publication remains unavailable until signed approval controls pass.
Bonzah coverage dependency and selected-price guard plus UE/VUW authority scenarios are expressible without customer branches.
